announcements.headline: Cambay PSC Update
announcements.insight: The update follows the June share options and July secretary change. Shareholders should watch for details in the October audited annual report.

announcements.headline: AGM – Notice of Meeting
announcements.insight: Synergia Energy Ltd NPV (SYN) has issued a notice for its Annual General Meeting. This follows the release of audited annual results for the year ended 30 June 26.

announcements.headline: Audited Annual Report for Year Ended 30 June 26
announcements.insight: Synergia Energy Ltd NPV (SYN) published its audited annual report for the year ended 30 June 26. This follows updates on Camelot CCS and Cambay PSC in June and July.

announcements.headline: Cambay PSC Update
announcements.insight: Synergia Energy Ltd NPV (SYN) provides an update on the Cambay PSC. This follows earlier announcements regarding Camelot CCS and share options issued in June.

announcements.headline: Change of Company Secretary
announcements.insight: Synergia Energy Ltd NPV (SYN) has appointed a new Company Secretary. This board change follows recent updates on Camelot CCS and Cambay PSC and a share option issue.

announcements.headline: Issue of Share Options
announcements.insight: Synergia Energy Ltd NPV (SYN) issued share options. This follows its Camelot CCS and Cambay PSC Update in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Camelot CCS and Cambay PSC Update
announcements.insight: Synergia Energy Ltd provides an update on Camelot CCS and Cambay PSC. Shareholders should monitor for further developments regarding these specific assets.
